Package ui

Class SalesDashboardPane

java.lang.Object
ui.SalesDashboardPane
public class SalesDashboardPane extends Object
Manager sales dashboard: total sales, orders, average ticket and top item for a date range and category, with charts of units sold by item and sales per day. Refunded orders are left out.
